name: 'Side effect' ad (a positive side effect framed as a warning)

shots.visual: Pharmacy-leaflet or drug-ad parody layout: white background, small-print serif, a "WARNING" bar in brand gold
One quick visual per side effect: a stranger pointing at the necklace, a hand in the sea, a sister wearing it
shots.audio_text: "strangers asking where it's from · forgetting you're wearing it · your sister borrowing it and never giving it back"

shots.visual: Fast-talking disclaimer voice over product close-up (the parody beat)
shots.audio_text: "Do not take off before showering. Ask your friends if [brand] is right for you."

prompts.prompt: Write 15 "side effects may include" lists for [product]. Each list has 4 effects that are social or emotional outcomes (compliments, never taking it off, someone stealing it). Never mention health, skin or medical outcomes.
Fast, flat, pharmaceutical-ad disclaimer delivery, male or female, speed 1.25x, stability 60. Text: "[parody disclaimer]".

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Never parody a real drug or imply any health effect; keep every "side effect" social.
Avoid: The parody must be obvious in the first second, or people will read it as a real warning.
Avoid: Featured example is a spec ad for a fictional product; check the format with a real product before scaling.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
